companyName: Centre Hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)

result.rationale: Reliable direct evidence resolves only 90% of current ProjectCo equity: Innisfree 55%, John Laing Health Montreal Limited 25%, and AtkinsRéalis 10%. The direct legal holder of the remaining 10% and that ownership period's effective date remain unproven, so a complete current ownership record cannot be published without speculation. The contemplated BBGI transaction was cancelled and creates no ownership period. KKR-managed funds are ultimate owners of John Laing rather than direct ProjectCo shareholders, and no direct current ProjectCo evidence supports Equitix or John Laing Investments Limited.
